device.description: High-voltage battery-pack monitor: two 24-bit current-shunt delta-sigma ADCs, one 16-bit 8-input sequenced ADC, overcurrent comparators, diagnostics and 9 GPIOs, SPI
device.note: ads131b23.pdf (SBASAP8B) p.4-5 pin functions (Table 4-1), p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.14-15 timing and switching characteristics, p.28-31 ADC1y digital filter, OSR and conversion data, p.52-54 power-up, reset, operating modes and ADC1y conversion modes (Equation 19), p.60-70 serial interface, frames, words, STATUS word, CRC, commands (Table 7-24), p.70-74 reading data and DRDYn pin behavior, p.74-212 register map (Table 8-1) and register descriptions

registers.name: ID
registers.note: REV[7:0] and DEVICE_ID[4:0] are factory values (reset X): modeled as 0; ADC_COUNT = 011b

registers.name: STATUS_MSB
registers.note: fault flags are active low; writing 1b clears them to 1b

registers.name: CONVERSION_CTRL
registers.note: STARTA, STARTB and SEQ2A_START always read back 0b: modeled read-only (a write of 1 still starts conversions)

commands.name: NULL
commands.note: the next frame outputs the STATUS word and the ADC1A / ADC1B data (the default out)

commands.name: RESET
commands.note: latched at the last SCLK of the output CRC word (modeled at CS rise)

commands.name: RREG
commands.note: the next frame (a NULL) outputs STATUS, then each register as 16 data bits + its 8-bit address; only the first register is modeled

commands.name: WREG CONVERSION_CTRL stop
commands.note: WREG of CONVERSION_CTRL (09h) with STOPA = 1 and STARTA = 0: stops continuous ADC1A conversions after the ongoing one

commands.name: WREG
commands.note: command word, command CRC word, then the register data words (16 bits MSB-aligned in 24-bit words) and the data CRC word; only the first register's word is modeled

pages: p.4-5 (pins), p.7 (ROC), p.14-15 (timing), p.28-31 (ADC1y filter, OSR, data), p.52-54 (modes, conversion modes), p.60-74 (serial interface, commands, reading data, DRDYn), p.74-212 (registers)
notModeled: this is a battery-pack monitor: only the SPI register interface and the ADC1A/ADC1B conversion timing are modeled; all analog parts (PGAs, muxes, references REFA/REFB, test DACs, open-wire current sources, temperature sensor, LDOs) are stored only and every result is the 0 V code

ADC1A and ADC1B are one conversion engine timed by ADC1A_CFG1 (CONV_MODE1A, OSR1A); ADC1B's own OSR/mode, separate STARTB timing, DRDY_CTRL (which ADC drives DRDYn), ADCxy_EN enables and global-chop mode (GC1y_EN, GC1y_DELAY) are not modeled

conversion time: continuous OSR / fMOD after the first; single-shot (3 x OSR + 44) / fMOD (Equation 19), at fMOD = 4.096 MHz (fMCLK 8.192 MHz); the first continuous conversion after STARTA also takes tSETTLE (modeled as OSR / fMOD)
ADC2A (16-bit, 8 inputs) and its 16-step sequencer (SEQ2A_STEPx_CFG, SEQ2A_START/STOP, SEQ2A_MODE, synchronized sequences): the SEQ2A_STEPx_DATA result registers stay at reset 0000h (= the 0 V code)

STOPx: only a single-register WREG of CONVERSION_CTRL with STOPA = 1 and STARTA = 0 stops conversions (other register bits of that write are dropped); STOPA/STOPB reading back 1 until stopped is not modeled
OP_MODE standby / power-down (DEVICE_CFG.OP_MODE) does not stop conversions; CLK_SOURCE, internal oscillators and clock monitors not modeled

every CRC: the command CRC and register-data CRC words are not checked (the real part executes nothing on a CRC mismatch), the output CRC word is output as zeros; CRC_TYPE, register map and memory map CRCs (REG_MAPx_CRC_EN, REGISTER_MAPx_CRC) not modeled
word length: modeled at the default 24-bit word size (DEVICE_CFG.WORD_LENGTH = 0); 32-bit words not modeled

multi-register RREG (only the first register with its address byte is output) and multi-register WREG (only the first register is written): the per-word padding cannot be expressed with rreg/wreg counts

STATUS word: COMMAND_RESPONSE is set to 1/2/3/4/6 per command; the error codes (1010b-1101b), the 0101b/1100b frame counter after RREG, the communication fault flags (SPI_CRC_FAULTn, SPI_TIMEOUTn, SCLK_COUNT_FAULTn, REG_ACCESS_FAULTn), CONV1A/CONV1B/SEQ2A counters, CLOCK and MODE indications are not modeled
LOCK: commands other than NULL, RREG and UNLOCK still execute while locked
supply, clock and digital monitors, fault flags and masks, FAULT pin, missing-host detection (MHD), overcurrent comparators (OCCA/OCCB pins, thresholds) not modeled
GPIOs (GPIO0-GPIO4, GPIO0A/1A/0B/1B), PWM outputs and readback: stored only, the pins are never driven; GPIO0A/1A/0B/1B use AVDD logic levels (listed in analog so the IOVDD check skips them)
SCLK counter and SPI timeout; SDO holding the last bit vs driving low after the frame (idle 0)
RESETn has an internal pulldown (floating = held in reset); the model treats Z as inactive

DRDYn: driven low during power-up/reset until the device is ready; goes high once the ADC1B data word is shifted out (clears on read) or when STARTx is written (clears on start); 4 tMCLK high pulse when data are not read
vcc 2.9-5.5 V is IOVDD (DPWR shorted to IOVDD, or the IOVDD LDO output from DPWR = 4-16 V); timing at 3.0-3.6 V IOVDD
variants: ADS131B23 datasheet; the skeleton's only orderable is ADS131B23PHPR (HTQFP-48 PHP). device id ADS131B23P follows the orderable prefix (the TI product is ADS131B23)
